instruction: I want to show the battery percentage in the top bar so I can monitor my laptop's power. Can you enable this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling battery percentage display. Evaluator verifies the show-battery-percentage setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the exact instruction requirement: enabling battery percentage display in the top bar
Getter uses the appropriate command 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage' to check the system setting
Metric 'exact_match' is correct for comparing the gsettings output
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct and matches actual gsettings command output format (including newline)
Setting is persistent system configuration, no UI state dependencies, no postconfig needed
Complete coverage: single requirement, single verification check
Runtime feasibility confirmed: command will execute successfully on Ubuntu GNOME environment
